answer: Shared-Resource Pulse Pricing. Each agent’s actions draw from a per-epoch coordination pool; identical or near-identical action timing clusters detected via correlation are charged at a rising rate, with the rate set at the pool’s utilization zenith. An attacker’s clones cannot whisper distinct timing without losing coordination value, and slipping past detection costs each identity a full pool re-buy per epoch—linear in clone count, not amortizable.
